transcript.text: I found a saved memory with the exact working definition of "leading region": the region whose customers placed the most orders, computed by joining `memory.bench.orders` to `memory.bench.customers` on `customer_id`, grouping by region, and counting orders.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY order_count DESC
